creator: Alexander Terp
description: Raised 2026-10-16 while building MUSTER_RESUME (a_2hIfv4FTx). Without MUSTER_RESUME, Claude Code's manifest carries a --settings or --mcp-config path off the running process. A wrapper that deletes that file after launch leaves a resume that fails at once: claude exits 'Settings file not found', and the pane drops to a shell. Dropping a file flag whose file has gone, and saying so in uncarried, is one option. MUSTER_RESUME is the full fix for wrappers; this is the fallback when none is set.
title: A resume carries a --settings or --mcp-config whose file is gone
